intro.lead: A connected ecosystem of products, workflows and technology for insurers, brokers, agents, customers and partners.
intro.sub: Modernize distribution. Connect operations. Create better experiences. Move insurance forward.

partners.placeholderNote: Placeholder marks, replace with real partner logos

platform.lead: Insurance now happens everywhere: through brokers, agents, digital platforms, merchants, partners and directly with customers.
platform.problem: But the technology behind these experiences is often fragmented.
platform.build: We build specialized products and technology that bring distribution, customer journeys, operations and servicing into a connected insurance ecosystem.

bento.sub: Six products for the people, channels and journeys that power modern insurance.
bento.noteOne: Each Verse solves a distinct challenge.
bento.noteTwo: Together, they cover the whole lifecycle.

salesverse.title: SalesVerse
salesverse.body: Insurance sales and new business, from first opportunity to issued policy.
salesverse.detail: Lead management, guided selling, digital applications and new-business operations in one structured journey.
salesverse.lede: Simplify new business, keep the sale visible and move every opportunity toward an issued policy.
points: Keep lead ownership clear across every channel
Turn customer interest into a complete application
Keep visibility after the seller clicks submit
Understand pipeline, conversion and turnaround

features.title: Guided selling
features.body: Product discovery, needs capture and approved content inside the conversation.

features.title: Digital application
features.body: Structured forms, documents, requirements and completeness checks before submission.

features.title: New-business operations
features.body: Review queues, underwriting hand-off, referrals and SLA visibility.

agentverse.title: AgentVerse
agentverse.body: Onboard, activate and enable the advisors who carry your distribution.
agentverse.detail: Recruitment, readiness, daily planning, customer portfolios, renewals and manager visibility for the field force.
agentverse.lede: Recruit, activate and enable the distribution workforce, and give every advisor one place to work.
points: Move new advisors from approved to ready to sell
Turn a list of customers into an actionable day
Keep the advisor useful after the policy is issued
Give managers the signals behind the numbers

features.title: Onboarding and activation
features.body: Candidate intake, readiness, documents and activation status.

features.title: Daily planner
features.body: Leads, appointments, tasks and reminders built for field work.

features.title: Coaching and performance
features.body: Targets, achievements, learning and manager visibility.

customerverse.title: CustomerVerse
customerverse.body: A policyholder experience that shows customers what needs attention next.
customerverse.detail: Policies, documents, payments, service requests, renewals and claim status, with assisted support when it is needed.
customerverse.lede: Give policyholders a clear digital destination, and surface the action that needs attention next.
points: One view of every policy the customer holds
Digital servicing instead of forms and follow-up
Guided renewal and payment moments
Assisted support when self-service is not enough

features.title: Policy and documents
features.body: Coverage information, schedules, certificates and notices in one place.

features.title: Payments and renewals
features.body: Due dates, payment links, reminders and digital renewal.

features.title: Claims visibility
features.body: Digital notification, evidence upload and status the customer can follow.

merchantverse.title: MerchantVerse
merchantverse.body: Onboard and govern the partners who take insurance to new customers.
merchantverse.detail: Partner application, business documents, review, approval, activation and one maintained partner record.
merchantverse.lede: Onboard, review, approve and govern the businesses through which insurance is distributed.
points: A structured entry point for prospective partners
Consistent review against the documents required
Traceable approval and activation decisions
One maintained record for every partner

features.title: Partner application
features.body: Guided submission, business information and supporting documents.

features.title: Review and approval
features.body: Queues, reviewers, information requests and a recorded decision trail.

features.title: Activation and status
features.body: Activation checklists, partner records and operational exceptions.

claimverse.title: ClaimVerse
claimverse.body: Claims orchestrated from first notice through decision and settlement.
claimverse.detail: Digital FNOL, evidence, triage, the handler workbench, assessment, authority controls and settlement.
claimverse.lede: Move a claim from first notice through assessment, decision and settlement with clearer control.
points: Cleaner intake without asking for everything at once
Route each claim down the path it actually needs
Evidence and judgement in one controlled workflow
Authority and audit around every settlement

features.title: Digital FNOL and triage
features.body: Guided notification, validation and rules-based routing.

features.title: Claims workbench
features.body: Timeline, documents, tasks, assessment and provider activity in one view.

features.title: Decision and settlement
features.body: Authority limits, approvals, payment connectivity and customer communication.

brokerverse.title: BrokerVerse
brokerverse.body: The operating platform behind the broker relationship.
brokerverse.detail: Clients, placement, policies, renewals, claims support, premiums and commissions in one insurance-first workspace.
brokerverse.lede: Run clients, placement, servicing, renewals and brokerage finance in one insurance-first workspace.
points: The whole client relationship in one record
Placement activity organized across carriers
Expiries turned into assigned, tracked work
Policy activity connected to broker revenue

features.title: Client and placement
features.body: Accounts, requirements, carrier responses and placement status.

features.title: Servicing and renewals
features.body: Policy records, endorsements, service cases and the renewal diary.

features.title: Premium and commission
features.body: Premiums, expected commission, reconciliation and receivables.
